root_causes.title: Incomplete candidate scope — missing outcome_spec
root_causes.evidence: Mechanical-tool candidates (adaptive_partition_compare, threshold_exploration) carry population_spec at research_scope top level but omit outcome_spec. Branch parent experiments hold outcome in pending_question_context. Identity derivation reads scope.outcome_spec only, leaving candidate outcome empty.
root_causes.effect: same_out=false in relationship classifier even when branch resolves the same outcome. Candidates fall through to RELATED_BUT_DISTINCT via same_unc AND (same_out OR same_pop) instead of SAME_QUESTION_DIFFERENT_INSTRUMENT which requires same_out AND same_pop AND same_horizon.

root_causes.title: Feature slice baked into scientific proposition key
root_causes.evidence: scientific_proposition_key() hashes feature_slice (partition_column, feature_column) into key suffix. rs10 vs rs_spread produce different keys despite identical pop/out hash prefix (7001d054a1ad35e8).
root_causes.effect: same_proposition=false even when pop/out/horizon/uncertainty align. Blocks NEAR_DUPLICATE and SAME_QUESTION paths that depend on proposition key equality.

root_causes.title: Spec source asymmetry — pending_question_context ignored for top-level scope
root_causes.evidence: _scope_specs reads scope.population_spec OR pending.population_spec but mechanical candidates store pop at scope level without copying pending outcome. Portfolio _spec_hashes reads ONLY pending_question_context, creating inconsistency between portfolio hashes and identity derivation.
root_causes.effect: Identity and portfolio dimension accounting disagree on what constitutes the scientific question.

root_causes.title: Legacy path — draft_spec absent on some frontier/portfolio items
root_causes.evidence: 36/300 BB12 novelty audits classified LEGACY_NO_SEMANTIC_CONTEXT (derive_identity_from_candidate returned None). Occurs early in session before full candidate draft specs materialize.
root_causes.effect: Fail-closed legacy path preserves raw novelty; no gating possible.

T4.vs_registry_prior: same_pop partial, same_out false (missing), same_unc true -> RELATED_BUT_DISTINCT or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
T4.representational_vs_scientific: Missing outcome is representational/incomplete metadata, not a new scientific question

T8.note: Different explanatory feature (rs_spread vs rs10) may be legitimately DISTINCT — not targeted for forced reclassification

T9.note: Same feature as T8 candidate; tool change alone may be representation if core question matches

fix_strategy.approach: Canonical proposition core separating scientific question from representation envelope; branch-context enrichment for missing outcome/pop; core-based relationship classification
